16x2 LCD (I2C 0x27): VCC 5V, GND, SDA -> A4, SCL -> A5 (shared with the BMP280)
Red LED anode -> 220 ohm -> D3, cathode -> GND
Green LED anode -> 220 ohm -> D4, cathode -> GND

name: Predictive Maintenance Demo
desc: Each button press waters for 5 s and measures how much the soil moisture rose. The first run sets the baseline; later runs are compared with it. Total run time is tracked, and when the response falls below 50 % of the baseline the red LED and the LCD predict a clogged line.
circuit: Pump: + -> 5V, - -> TIP122 collector; base <- D9 via 1k, emitter -> GND; 1N4007 across the pump (flyback)
Soil moisture probe: VCC 5V, GND, AO -> A3 (dry = high reading)
16x2 LCD (I2C 0x27): VCC 5V, GND, SDA -> A4, SCL -> A5 (shared with the BMP280)
Push button between D2 and GND (INPUT_PULLUP, pressed = LOW)
Red LED anode -> 220 ohm -> D3, cathode -> GND

name: Multi-Page Safety Dashboard
desc: Four LCD pages (gases, flame and status, climate, pressure) selected with the button. Whenever a danger exists (gas over 50 %, flame, AQI over 150, humidity over 90 %) an alert banner replaces the first row on every page.
circuit: 16x2 LCD (I2C 0x27): VCC 5V, GND, SDA -> A4, SCL -> A5 (shared with the BMP280)
MQ-2: VCC 5V, GND, AO -> A0 (higher = more gas / smoke)
MQ-135: VCC 5V, GND, AO -> A1 (higher = worse air)
Flame sensor: VCC 5V, GND, DO -> D10 (LOW when a flame is seen; the board pot sets the threshold)
DHT22: VCC 5V, GND, DATA -> D7
BMP280: VCC 5V, GND, SDA -> A4, SCL -> A5 (I2C 0x76)
Push button between D2 and GND (INPUT_PULLUP, pressed = LOW)

name: Safety Compliance Self-Check
desc: At boot every device is tested in turn and the result is shown on the LCD and printed: gas sensors (heated, in range), flame (idle), rain (dry), soil (in range), DHT22, DS18B20, BMP280 (plausible values), then a relay click and a buzzer beep. A PASS / FAIL summary lists the failures.
circuit: MQ-2: VCC 5V, GND, AO -> A0 (higher = more gas / smoke)
MQ-135: VCC 5V, GND, AO -> A1 (higher = worse air)
Flame sensor: VCC 5V, GND, DO -> D10 (LOW when a flame is seen; the board pot sets the threshold)
Rain sensor: VCC 5V, GND, AO -> A2 (dry = high reading)
Soil moisture probe: VCC 5V, GND, AO -> A3 (dry = high reading)
DHT22: VCC 5V, GND, DATA -> D7
DS18B20 probe: VCC 5V, GND, DATA -> D8 with a 10k pull-up from DATA to 5V
BMP280: VCC 5V, GND, SDA -> A4, SCL -> A5 (I2C 0x76)
Relay module: DC+ 5V, DC- GND, IN <- D6 (active LOW: LOW = relay on)
Active buzzer + -> D5, - -> GND (HIGH = beep)
16x2 LCD (I2C 0x27): VCC 5V, GND, SDA -> A4, SCL -> A5 (shared with the BMP280)
